sections.A: Gardan ki arteries dimagh ko khoon pohanchati hain. Dissection mein artery ki andar ki deewar phat jati hai aur stroke ho sakta hai. Shuru mein sirf gardan ka dard ho sakta hai, jo aam dard jaisa lagta hai.
sections.B: Naya, ajeeb aur shadeed gardan ya sar ka dard, saath mein chakkar, double vision, bolne ya nigalne mein mushkil, girna, matli ya sunn-pan (5 Ds aur 3 Ns).
sections.C: Poochein ke kya yeh dard pehle se mukhtalif hai, haal mein gardan ko jhatka laga, aur kya chakkar, double vision ya bolne mein masla hai.
sections.D: BP, cranial nerves, coordination aur UMN screen. Bohat zyada BP bhi khatre ki nishani hai.
sections.E: Positional tests ki accuracy pakki nahi. Negative test ka matlab yeh nahi ke patient safe hai. History aur reasoning sab se ahem hain.
sections.F: Aam gardan dard, migraine, BPPV aur cervicogenic headache isi jaise lag sakte hain, lekin unmein neuro signs nahi hote.
sections.G: Naya shadeed dard ke saath 5 Ds, 3 Ns, Horner syndrome, ek taraf ki kamzori ya instability ke signs: emergency referral.
sections.H: Kisi bhi gardan ke treatment se pehle poochein: naya dard? neuro symptoms? chot? risk factors? Neuro signs ke saath koi bhi haan ho to emergency.
sections.I: Physiotherapy dissection ka ilaaj nahi karti. Hamara kaam pehchanna, refer karna, aur doctor ke baad halki rehab hai.
sections.M: Har visit par neuro symptoms dobara poochein. Naya symptom aaye to plan wahin rok dein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein, phir jawab dekhein. Yaad rakhein: negative test kisi ko manipulation ke liye clear nahi karta.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
